phase_help.alignment: Registering all frames of a series onto a common pixel grid so each star keeps the same coordinates throughout the night.
phase_help.calibration: Removing the camera signature from raw frames with master darks and flats, plus sanity gates that catch a wrong or stale master.
phase_help.comp_selection: Choosing the ensemble of constant stars for differential photometry: color, brightness, distance, stability, isolation and coverage. Several limits adapt to field density.
phase_help.detection: Finding stars, solving sky coordinates (including the blind solver), building the masterstar catalog, matching Gaia, and classifying field density and variability.
phase_help.export: Output for the outside world: AAVSO/VarAstro submission and TESS cross-analysis.
phase_help.extinction: Correcting for the atmosphere: second-order extinction (k2) that depends on star color and airmass, and optional color-term handling.
phase_help.observer: Who observed and from where: AAVSO identity and observing-site coordinates. Observatory facts; the database LOCATION table is the source of truth.
phase_help.paths: Where VYVAR finds its data on disk: star catalogs, plate-solve indexes, the archive and the calibration library. Machine-specific plumbing - set once, then forget.
phase_help.photometry: Measuring star brightness: aperture sizing, sky annulus, error model, aperture correction, optional PSF photometry and detrending. The heart of the pipeline.
phase_help.qc: Automatic per-frame checks (sharpness, elongation, background, star counts) and optional gates that drop bad frames, plus the sky-surface preprocess.
phase_help.reports: What appears in the PDF summary report: the color HR diagram of the field, optional online enrichment (SIMBAD, Gaia), and its visual tuning.
phase_help.system: Machine-level behavior: parallel workers and RAM reserves. Computed from your hardware; override only when you must.
phase_help.trust: How VYVAR grades its own results: GREEN/YELLOW/RED trust of the comparison ensemble and check star, minimum epochs and frames, and light-curve quality thresholds.

aavso_filter_map.help: Optional mapping of your local filter names to official AAVSO filter codes used in exports (e.g. 'NoFilter' -> 'CV').
aavso_filter_map.label: AAVSO Filter Map

admission_sat_peak_frac.help: D5-2 / C-1 admission gate. Reject comparison stars whose peak exceeds this fraction of full well. Distinct from the 85 percent is_saturated flag; 0.70 was set by the batch E re-cut.
admission_sat_peak_frac.label: Admission Sat Peak Frac

alignment_detection_sigma.help: Detection sensitivity of the star finder used to pick alignment control stars.
alignment_detection_sigma.label: Alignment Detection Sigma

alignment_max_control_points.help: Maximum number of control points the aligner may use per frame; more is robuster but slower.
alignment_max_control_points.label: Alignment Max Control Points

alignment_max_stars.help: Cap on stars considered by the alignment matcher.
alignment_max_stars.label: Alignment Max Stars

annulus_inner_fwhm.help: Inner radius of the sky annulus in FWHM units (APERTURE-01d: 2.7, AIJ Sky_Inner at this FWHM). Stamped per frame as sky_annulus_r_in_px. Density +1.0 is Phase 1 effective cfg only.
annulus_inner_fwhm.label: Annulus Inner FWHM

annulus_outer_fwhm.help: Outer radius of the sky annulus in FWHM units (APERTURE-01d: 5.2, AIJ Sky_Outer at this FWHM). Stamped per frame as sky_annulus_r_out_px.
annulus_outer_fwhm.label: Annulus Outer FWHM

aperture_comp_factor.help: Aperture size multiplier applied to comparison stars.
aperture_comp_factor.label: Aperture Comp Factor

aperture_correction_enabled.help: Enables aperture correction: transferring flux measured in a small aperture to the total-flux scale using bright reference stars.
aperture_correction_enabled.label: Aperture Correction Enabled

aperture_correction_max_contamination.help: Maximum neighbour contamination a reference star may have to be used for aperture correction.
aperture_correction_max_contamination.label: Aperture Correction Max Contamination

aperture_correction_max_scatter_mag.help: Maximum scatter (mag) allowed among aperture-correction reference stars.
aperture_correction_max_scatter_mag.label: Aperture Correction Max Scatter Mag

aperture_correction_min_ref_stars.help: Minimum reference stars required to compute an aperture correction.
aperture_correction_min_ref_stars.label: Aperture Correction Min Ref Stars

aperture_fwhm_factor.help: Base aperture radius in FWHM units (APERTURE-01c Milan GO f=1.35). Same f for every star in the frame; r_ap = f x FWHM. Scatter ladder is diagnostic only.
aperture_fwhm_factor.label: Aperture FWHM Factor

aperture_photometry_enabled.help: Master switch of aperture photometry - the production measurement method of VYVAR.
aperture_photometry_enabled.label: Aperture Photometry Enabled

aperture_policy_mode.help: APERTURE-01 production radius: f_fixed_night = f x median FWHM of the night (one r for the draft); f_per_frame = f x QC FWHM of that frame. Same r for target, comps, and pool. The SNR mag-bin table is diagnostic only.
aperture_policy_mode.label: Aperture Policy Mode

aperture_snr_sizing.help: SNR-optimal aperture sizing sweep bounds as FWHM multiples: 'small' is the minimum radius (best for faint stars), 'large' the maximum. WAVE-B merged the former aperture_fwhm_factor_small/_large scalars into this mapping (there is no medium class).
aperture_snr_sizing.label: Aperture SNR Sizing

aperture_variable_factor.help: Aperture size multiplier applied to the variable (target) star.
aperture_variable_factor.label: Aperture Variable Factor

apply_color_term.help: Whether a color-term transformation is applied to magnitudes ('off' keeps instrumental system).
apply_color_term.label: Apply Color Term

archive_root.help: Root folder of the observation archive (raw and processed drafts). Resolved per machine at startup.
archive_root.label: Archive Root

auto_fwhm_enabled.help: Automatically derives the frame-quality FWHM limit from the night's own seeing statistics instead of a fixed number.
auto_fwhm_enabled.label: Auto FWHM Enabled

auto_fwhm_k_factor.help: Multiplier applied to the night's median FWHM when deriving the automatic quality limit.
auto_fwhm_k_factor.label: Auto FWHM K Factor

auto_fwhm_k_max.help: Upper clamp of the automatic FWHM limit multiplier.
auto_fwhm_k_max.label: Auto FWHM K Max

auto_fwhm_k_min.help: Lower clamp of the automatic FWHM limit multiplier.
auto_fwhm_k_min.label: Auto FWHM K Min

blind_img_select_mode.help: Strategy for picking which detected stars feed the blind solver ('per_cell' spreads them evenly across the frame).
blind_img_select_mode.label: Blind Img Select Mode

blind_img_star_budget.help: Maximum number of image stars handed to the blind solver; a budget keeps solving fast.
blind_img_star_budget.label: Blind Img Star Budget

blind_index_fine_path.help: Path to the fine-scale astrometric index used by the blind plate solver for narrow-field rigs.
blind_index_fine_path.label: Blind Index Fine Path

blind_index_select_mode.help: How the blind solver picks its index: 'auto' chooses fine or wide by the rig's field of view; can be forced manually.
blind_index_select_mode.label: Blind Index Select Mode

blind_index_wide_path.help: Path to the wide-field astrometric index used by the blind plate solver for wide rigs (e.g. the 200mm Zeiss).
blind_index_wide_path.label: Blind Index Wide Path

blind_use_rig_prior.help: Uses the known rig plate scale as a prior to reject implausible blind-solve candidates early.
blind_use_rig_prior.label: Blind Use Rig Prior

blind_verify_early_accept.help: Number of verified star matches at which the blind solver stops early and accepts the solution.
blind_verify_early_accept.label: Blind Verify Early Accept

blind_verify_early_floor.help: Minimum matches required before early acceptance may trigger at all.
blind_verify_early_floor.label: Blind Verify Early Floor

blind_verify_early_fraction.help: Fraction of catalog stars that must match for early acceptance.
blind_verify_early_fraction.label: Blind Verify Early Fraction

blind_verify_enabled.help: Verifies every blind-solve candidate against the Gaia catalog before trusting it - the safety net of blind solving.
blind_verify_enabled.label: Blind Verify Enabled

blind_verify_inmemory_catalog.help: Keeps the verification catalog in memory for speed instead of re-querying the database.
blind_verify_inmemory_catalog.label: Blind Verify Inmemory Catalog

blind_verify_match_tol_arcsec.help: Blind verify match tolerance in arcsec. None uses legacy blind_verify_match_tol_px.
blind_verify_match_tol_arcsec.label: Blind Verify Match Tol Arcsec

blind_verify_match_tol_px.help: Pixel tolerance when matching image stars to catalog positions during verification.
blind_verify_match_tol_px.label: Blind Verify Match Tol PX

blind_verify_min_fraction.help: Minimum fraction of stars that must match for a blind solution to pass verification.
blind_verify_min_fraction.label: Blind Verify Min Fraction

blind_verify_min_matches.help: Absolute minimum of matched stars for a verified blind solution.
blind_verify_min_matches.label: Blind Verify Min Matches

blind_verify_top_n.help: How many best blind candidates get the full verification treatment.
blind_verify_top_n.label: Blind Verify Top N

bpm_dark_mad_sigma.help: Sensitivity of bad-pixel detection on the master dark: pixels deviating more than this many robust sigmas are mapped as defective.
bpm_dark_mad_sigma.label: Bpm Dark Mad Sigma

calibration_library_native_binning.help: Binning in which the calibration library masters were built; masters get resampled (with provenance flag) when a draft uses another binning.
calibration_library_native_binning.label: Calibration Library Native Binning

calibration_library_root.help: Root folder of the calibration library (master darks/flats organized by camera, binning and temperature). Resolved per machine.
calibration_library_root.label: Calibration Library Root

calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.help: Maximum allowed CCD temperature difference (deg C) between a master dark and the light frames it calibrates.
calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.label: Calibration Master CCD TEMP Tolerance C

catalog_query_max_rows.help: Cap on rows returned by a single Gaia catalog query; protects memory on very dense fields.
catalog_query_max_rows.label: Catalog Query Max Rows

check_select_rms_floor.help: RMS floor in check-star selection scoring.
check_select_rms_floor.label: Check Select RMS Floor

check_star_min_epochs.help: Minimum epochs the check star must cover for its quality verdict to count.
check_star_min_epochs.label: Check Star Min Epochs

cog_ac_factor_max.help: Upper clamp of the curve-of-growth aperture-correction factor.
cog_ac_factor_max.label: COG Ac Factor Max

cog_aperture_correction_enabled.help: Enables the curve-of-growth variant of aperture correction (experimental alternative).
cog_aperture_correction_enabled.label: COG Aperture Correction Enabled

cog_isolation_fwhm.help: Isolation radius (FWHM) a star needs to serve as a curve-of-growth reference.
cog_isolation_fwhm.label: COG Isolation FWHM

cog_ladder_step_fwhm.help: COG ladder step as multiple of measured FWHM. None uses legacy cog_ladder_step_px.
cog_ladder_step_fwhm.label: COG Ladder Step FWHM

cog_ladder_step_px.help: Radius step (px) of the curve-of-growth aperture ladder.
cog_ladder_step_px.label: COG Ladder Step PX

cog_min_stars.help: Minimum stars needed to fit a curve of growth.
cog_min_stars.label: COG Min Stars

cog_ref_fwhm.help: Reference FWHM used to normalize the curve of growth.
cog_ref_fwhm.label: COG Ref FWHM

cog_sat_frac.help: Saturation-fraction cutoff for curve-of-growth reference stars.
cog_sat_frac.label: COG Sat Frac

cog_snr_min.help: Minimum SNR of a curve-of-growth reference star.
cog_snr_min.label: COG SNR Min

color_level_k_mag_per_bprp.help: Per-rig Clear/unfiltered level colour coefficient (mag per BP-RP). Measured; not universal. Export-only constant correction.
color_level_k_mag_per_bprp.label: Color Level K

color_level_k_stderr_mag_per_bprp.help: Uncertainty on color_level_k_mag_per_bprp; propagates into exported magnitude errors.
color_level_k_stderr_mag_per_bprp.label: Color Level K Stderr

comp_color_tiers.help: Ordered color-match tiers for comparison weighting. Each entry is a BP-RP color-match limit ('bprp', tighter = better color match) and the ensemble weight ('w') for stars in that tier. WAVE-B merged the eight comp_tier{1..4}_bprp_limit / _weight scalars into this list of dicts.
comp_color_tiers.label: Comp Color Tiers

comp_contamination_penalty_k.help: Weight penalty strength for contaminated comparison stars in ensemble weighting.
comp_contamination_penalty_k.label: Comp Contamination Penalty K

comp_max_delta_bprp.help: Maximum Gaia BP-RP color difference between a comparison star and the target - the primary defense against extinction systematics on unfiltered data; density adaptation adjusts it.
comp_max_delta_bprp.label: Comp Max Delta BPRP

comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.help: Maximum linear trend (mmag/hour) a comparison star may show before being rejected as drifting.
comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.label: Comp Max Slope Mmag Hr

comp_pool_derived_admission.help: COMP-ADMIT-03: when True, run draft noise-curve diagnostics and drop only known variables (VSX/Gaia). Scatter/colour/distance enter continuous weights, not cuts.
comp_pool_derived_admission.label: Comp Pool Derived Admission

comp_qa_enabled.help: Per-epoch quality assessment of the comparison ensemble feeding the trust verdict.
comp_qa_enabled.label: Comp Qa Enabled

comp_select_rms_floor.help: Numerical floor of comparison RMS in weighting (prevents division blow-ups).
comp_select_rms_floor.label: Comp Select RMS Floor

comp_slope_significance_k.help: Statistical significance required before a comparison star's trend counts as real drift.
comp_slope_significance_k.label: Comp Slope Significance K

comp_sparse_fallback_enabled.help: Allows the sparse-field fallback path when strict criteria yield too few comparisons.
comp_sparse_fallback_enabled.label: Comp Sparse Fallback Enabled

comp_sparse_fallback_min.help: Minimum comparisons the sparse fallback aims for (0 = take what exists).
comp_sparse_fallback_min.label: Comp Sparse Fallback Min

comp_trust_min_comps.help: GREEN trust threshold of ensemble size (default 5 per literature; production runs 3 with sigma scaled by N - see DECISIONS). Fewer comps degrade to YELLOW, not RED.
comp_trust_min_comps.label: Comp Trust Min Comps

comp_weight_airmass_span.help: Airmass span of the series used when deriving c_col = |k2_bprp| * DeltaX.
comp_weight_airmass_span.label: Comp Weight Airmass Span

comp_weight_c_col_mag_per_bprp.help: COMP-ADMIT-03 colour systematic coefficient in the weight sigma_eff (mag per BP-RP). None = derive from |k2|*airmass_span.
comp_weight_c_col_mag_per_bprp.label: Comp Weight c_col

comp_weight_c_dist_mag_per_deg.help: COMP-ADMIT-03 distance systematic coefficient in sigma_eff (mag per degree). None = measure from draft or named zero.
comp_weight_c_dist_mag_per_deg.label: Comp Weight c_dist

comparison_stars_pool_n.help: Plan/spatial comparison pool size. 0 = uncapped (COMP-POOL-01); legacy default was 150.
comparison_stars_pool_n.label: Comparison Stars Pool N

crowding_blend_tighten_threshold.help: Blend-fraction level above which the (experimental) crowding classifier would tighten comparison criteria.
crowding_blend_tighten_threshold.label: Crowding Blend Tighten Threshold

crowding_classifier_enabled.help: Experimental crowding classifier switch; OFF pending validation on Newton dense-field data.
crowding_classifier_enabled.label: Crowding Classifier Enabled

crowding_comp_availability_loosen_count.help: Comparison-star availability level treated as plentiful when the crowding logic decides about loosening.
crowding_comp_availability_loosen_count.label: Crowding Comp Availability Loosen Count

crowding_tighten_min_fwhm_px.help: Minimum FWHM (px) below which crowding-driven tightening is not applied (undersampled images).
crowding_tighten_min_fwhm_px.label: Crowding Tighten Min FWHM PX

dao_centroid_max_shift_fwhm.help: E.2. Maximum DAO-vs-WCS centroid shift, in units of FWHM, before a matched star falls back to its WCS pixel position.
dao_centroid_max_shift_fwhm.label: Dao Centroid Max Shift Fwhm

dao_detection_n_equiv.help: T4-1 Option B. Effective number of independent pixels per resolution element on the resampled detection image; DAO threshold is N_equiv * rms_conv. Measured from audit Part 2b (rel_err=1.09 -> 3.78; legacy 1.36 -> 4.71).
dao_detection_n_equiv.label: Dao Detection N Equiv

dao_qc_in_calibrate.help: Runs the star-detection based QC directly during calibration so bad frames are flagged as early as possible.
dao_qc_in_calibrate.label: DAO QC In Calibrate

database_path.help: Path to the main VYVAR SQLite database (drafts, equipment, locations, results). Resolved per machine.
database_path.label: Database Path

debug_platesolver.help: Verbose diagnostic logging of the plate solver; for troubleshooting only.
debug_platesolver.label: Debug Platesolver

democratic_detrend_enabled.help: Optional 'democratic' detrend of the light curve (median trend of the field); OFF by default - detrending can eat real variability.
democratic_detrend_enabled.label: Democratic Detrend Enabled

democratic_sg_window_frac.help: Window width (fraction of the night) of the democratic detrend smoother.
democratic_sg_window_frac.label: Democratic SG Window Frac

epsf_auto_run.help: When true, RUN VYVAR / night_run automatically runs the ePSF stage after aperture photometry. Default OFF. Distinct from psf_photometry_enabled (Phase 2A psf_* columns). UI ePSF buttons still force the stage.
epsf_auto_run.label: EPSF Auto Run

epsf_min_stars.help: Minimum suitable stars required to build an empirical PSF model (ePSF) for PSF photometry.
epsf_min_stars.label: EPSF Min Stars

err_empty_apertures_min.help: Minimum empty apertures required for a valid empirical background estimate.
err_empty_apertures_min.label: Err Empty Apertures Min

err_empty_apertures_n.help: How many empty apertures are placed per frame for the empirical background noise measurement.
err_empty_apertures_n.label: Err Empty Apertures N

exoplanet_local_db_path.help: Path to the local NASA Exoplanet Archive database used to cross-match detected stars with known exoplanet hosts.
exoplanet_local_db_path.label: Exoplanet Local Db Path

exoplanet_match_max_sep_arcsec.help: Maximum sky separation (arcsec) for identifying a detected star with a known exoplanet host.
exoplanet_match_max_sep_arcsec.label: Exoplanet Match Max Sep Arcsec

export_arcsec_per_px.help: Plate-scale label written into export metadata; the science value comes from the WCS. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback (derivable from WCS/optics).
export_arcsec_per_px.label: Export Arcsec Per PX

field_density_adaptive_enabled.help: Master switch of density adaptation: sparse/normal/dense field profiles automatically loosen or tighten comparison-star criteria.
field_density_adaptive_enabled.label: Field Density Adaptive Enabled

field_density_dense_threshold.help: Matched-star count above which the field is treated as dense (tighter criteria).
field_density_dense_threshold.label: Field Density Dense Threshold

field_density_sparse_threshold.help: Matched-star count below which the field is treated as sparse (looser criteria so an ensemble can still be formed).
field_density_sparse_threshold.label: Field Density Sparse Threshold

forced_photometry_centroid_bound_fwhm.help: Bounded peak refine search radius in FWHM units for forced photometry.
forced_photometry_centroid_bound_fwhm.label: Forced Photometry Centroid Bound Fwhm

forced_photometry_enabled.help: Inject force-eligible MASTERSTAR members missing from DAO each frame.
forced_photometry_enabled.label: Forced Photometry Enabled

forced_photometry_margin_px.help: Extra pixel margin for forced-photometry footprint geometry gate.
forced_photometry_margin_px.label: Forced Photometry Margin Px

frame_align_residual_gate_enabled.help: Optional gate dropping frames whose alignment residuals are unusually large (poorly registered frames).
frame_align_residual_gate_enabled.label: Frame Align Residual Gate Enabled

frame_align_residual_max_frac.help: Maximum fraction of frames the alignment-residual gate may drop; protects against discarding the night.
frame_align_residual_max_frac.label: Frame Align Residual Max Frac

frame_align_residual_min_keep_frames.help: Minimum number of frames that must survive the alignment-residual gate.
frame_align_residual_min_keep_frames.label: Frame Align Residual Min Keep Frames

frame_height_px.help: Frame height in pixels; measured from FITS NAXIS2 at run time. WAVE-B internalized it (no longer stored in config.json).
frame_height_px.label: Frame Height PX

frame_width_px.help: Frame width in pixels; measured from FITS NAXIS1 at run time. WAVE-B internalized it (no longer stored in config.json).
frame_width_px.label: Frame Width PX

gaia_db_path.help: Path to the local full-sky Gaia DR3 SQLite database (40M+ stars) used for star identification and comparison selection.
gaia_db_path.label: Gaia Db Path

gain.help: Native-domain detector gain (e-/ADU_native). Science photon/SNR terms use container-domain gain via gain_photon_transfer (g_pt or gain/gain_container_scale); never bare DB gain on container ADU (WIDE-ERR-03).
gain.label: Gain

gs11_comp_max_dilution.help: Maximum dilution (flux contamination) a comparison star may have under the GS11 dilution model.
gs11_comp_max_dilution.label: GS11 Comp Max Dilution

gs11_dilution_aperture_arcsec.help: Aperture (arcsec) used when computing catalog-based dilution; 0 derives it from the photometric aperture.
gs11_dilution_aperture_arcsec.label: GS11 Dilution Aperture Arcsec

gs11_dilution_enabled.help: Enables catalog-based dilution estimation (how much neighbour light leaks into apertures).
gs11_dilution_enabled.label: GS11 Dilution Enabled

gs11_dilution_mag_limit_delta.help: How many magnitudes fainter than the star the dilution census still counts neighbours.
gs11_dilution_mag_limit_delta.label: GS11 Dilution Mag Limit Delta

gs11_target_min_dilution.help: Minimum acceptable target dilution before the target is flagged as badly blended.
gs11_target_min_dilution.label: GS11 Target Min Dilution

hrd_color_bg_box_arcsec.help: HR diagram local background box in arcsec. None uses legacy hrd_color_bg_box_px.
hrd_color_bg_box_arcsec.label: HRD Color BG Box Arcsec

hrd_color_bg_box_px.help: Background sampling box (px) for star colors in the color HR diagram.
hrd_color_bg_box_px.label: HRD Color Bg Box PX

hrd_color_chroma_boost.help: Chroma amplification of the HRD star colors for visual clarity.
hrd_color_chroma_boost.label: HRD Color Chroma Boost

hrd_color_chroma_snr.help: Minimum color SNR before a star gets a saturated color in the HRD.
hrd_color_chroma_snr.label: HRD Color Chroma SNR

hrd_color_field_enabled.help: Renders the color HR diagram of the observed field in the report.
hrd_color_field_enabled.label: HRD Color Field Enabled

hrd_color_highlight_mode.help: Highlight style of interesting objects in the HRD ('soft' = gentle emphasis).
hrd_color_highlight_mode.label: HRD Color Highlight Mode

hrd_color_saturation.help: Base color saturation of HRD points.
hrd_color_saturation.label: HRD Color Saturation

hrd_color_white_point.help: White-point reference of HRD colors ('field_median' balances to the field's median color).
hrd_color_white_point.label: HRD Color White Point

hrd_dsc_confirm_prob.help: Probability threshold for confirming a candidate's HRD-based classification.
hrd_dsc_confirm_prob.label: HRD DSC Confirm Prob

hrd_enrich_max_candidates.help: Cap on objects sent to online enrichment services per report.
hrd_enrich_max_candidates.label: HRD Enrich Max Candidates

hrd_enrich_tap_timeout_s.help: Timeout (s) of TAP queries during online enrichment.
hrd_enrich_tap_timeout_s.label: HRD Enrich Tap Timeout S

hrd_max_per_category.help: Maximum highlighted objects per category in the HRD legend.
hrd_max_per_category.label: HRD Max Per Category

hrd_min_per_net.help: Minimum objects kept per detection net when trimming HRD highlights.
hrd_min_per_net.label: HRD Min Per Net

hrd_nss_category_enabled.help: Adds the Gaia non-single-star category to HRD highlights.
hrd_nss_category_enabled.label: HRD NSS Category Enabled

hrd_online_enrich_enabled.help: Online enrichment of interesting HRD objects from Gaia archive services.
hrd_online_enrich_enabled.label: HRD Online Enrich Enabled

hrd_parallax_min_mas.help: Minimum parallax (mas) for placing a star in the absolute-magnitude HRD.
hrd_parallax_min_mas.label: HRD Parallax Min Mas

hrd_parallax_snr_min.help: Minimum parallax SNR for a trustworthy HRD position.
hrd_parallax_snr_min.label: HRD Parallax SNR Min

hrd_simbad_enrich_enabled.help: SIMBAD lookups for object types of HRD highlights.
hrd_simbad_enrich_enabled.label: HRD Simbad Enrich Enabled

k2_ceiling.help: Upper cap of the fitted second-order extinction coefficient k2 (mag per airmass per color unit).
k2_ceiling.label: K2 Ceiling

k2_defaults_bprp.help: Per-band literature defaults of k2 keyed by BP-RP, used when fitting is off or fails.
k2_defaults_bprp.label: K2 Defaults BPRP

k2_fit_consistency_sigma.help: Consistency requirement (sigma) between the fitted k2 and expectations before the fit is trusted.
k2_fit_consistency_sigma.label: K2 Fit Consistency Sigma

k2_fit_enabled.help: Enables per-night fitting of the second-order extinction coefficient (v2 NIGHT_FIT; OFF until validated).
k2_fit_enabled.label: K2 Fit Enabled

k2_fit_lit_factor.help: Allowed multiple of the literature k2 value; fits outside it are rejected as unphysical.
k2_fit_lit_factor.label: K2 Fit Lit Factor

k2_fit_min_detectability.help: Minimum detectability (signal strength) the night must offer for a k2 fit to be attempted.
k2_fit_min_detectability.label: K2 Fit Min Detectability

k2_mode.help: Source of k2: 'literature' (defaults) or fitted per night when the fit program is enabled.
k2_mode.label: K2 Mode

lc_quality_min_frames.help: Minimum frames for a full-quality light-curve verdict.
lc_quality_min_frames.label: Lc Quality Min Frames

lc_quality_min_normal_frac.help: Minimum fraction of normal (unflagged) points a light curve needs.
lc_quality_min_normal_frac.label: Lc Quality Min Normal Frac

lc_quality_short_min_frames.help: Frame floor of the short-baseline quality track for brief series.
lc_quality_short_min_frames.label: Lc Quality Short Min Frames

masterdark_validity_days.help: How many days a master dark stays valid; older masters trigger a warning to shoot new darks (currently ~21.7. deadline).
masterdark_validity_days.label: Masterdark Validity Days

masterflat_validity_days.help: How many days a master flat stays valid before VYVAR asks for a fresh one.
masterflat_validity_days.label: Masterflat Validity Days

masterstar_best_of_n.help: How many best frames are stacked/considered when building the masterstar reference.
masterstar_best_of_n.label: Masterstar Best Of N

masterstar_catalog_recovery_min.help: Minimum fraction of catalog stars the masterstar must recover for the solution to be trusted.
masterstar_catalog_recovery_min.label: Masterstar Catalog Recovery Min

masterstar_centre_rms_max_arcsec.help: MASTERSTAR centre RMS gate in arcsec. None uses legacy masterstar_centre_rms_max_px.
masterstar_centre_rms_max_arcsec.label: Masterstar Centre RMS Max Arcsec

masterstar_centre_rms_max_px.help: Maximum RMS (px) of star positions near the frame centre for an acceptable astrometric solution.

masterstar_dao_pass2_sigma.help: Detection sigma of the second, deeper DAO pass on the masterstar stack.

masterstar_dao_centroid_qa_cap_px.help: Upper cap [px] when deriving pass2/seed centroid tolerances from astrometric residual p95.

masterstar_dao_centroid_qa_floor_px.help: Lower floor [px] when deriving pass2/seed centroid tolerances from astrometric residual p95.
masterstar_dao_centroid_qa_floor_px.label: Masterstar DAO Centroid QA Floor PX

masterstar_dao_empty_sky_false_accept_ma.help: Empty-sky audit (INV-DET-FALSEFILL-01): maximum false-accept rate at MASTERSTAR build.

masterstar_dao_empty_sky_target_n.help: Empty-sky audit sample size (main-field positions) for false-fill rate measurement.

masterstar_dao_match_radius_k.help: Gaia match radius multiplier k times astrometric residual p95 [px] (DAO-GAIA-ERA-01).

masterstar_dao_pass1_dedup_px.help: Pass1 spatial deduplication radius [px] before pass2 targeted cutouts.

masterstar_dao_pass2_center_tol_px.help: Maximum centroid offset [px] for pass2 cutout acceptance at Gaia seed positions.

masterstar_detection_cap_adaptive.help: Adapts the detection cap to field density instead of a fixed count.
masterstar_detection_cap_adaptive.label: Masterstar Detection Cap Adaptive

masterstar_detection_cap_k.help: Scaling constant of the adaptive detection cap.

masterstar_detection_cap_max.help: Upper clamp of the adaptive detection cap.

masterstar_detection_cap_min.help: Lower clamp of the adaptive detection cap.
masterstar_detection_cap_min.label: Masterstar Detection Cap Min

masterstar_distortion_benign_ratio_max.help: Limit on the edge-to-centre distortion ratio still considered benign for the optics.

masterstar_forced_seed_centroid_max_px.help: FORCED_SEED admission: max COM centroid offset from propagated Gaia [px].
masterstar_forced_seed_centroid_max_px.label: Masterstar Forced Seed Centroid Max PX

masterstar_forced_seed_comp_pool_enabled.help: Admit FORCED_SEED stars into the comp/CT pool (default off).

masterstar_forced_seed_snr_min.help: FORCED_SEED admission: minimum aperture SNR on local annulus background.
masterstar_forced_seed_snr_min.label: Masterstar Forced Seed SNR Min

masterstar_gaia_census_edge_margin_px.help: Gaia-complete census: edge margin [px] for EDGE source_state classification.
masterstar_gaia_census_edge_margin_px.label: Masterstar Gaia Census Edge Margin PX

masterstar_gaia_census_target_depth_g.help: Gaia-complete census + pass2 seed window: maximum G magnitude.
masterstar_gaia_census_target_depth_g.label: Masterstar Gaia Census Target Depth G

masterstar_lock_leftover_radius_px.help: FORCED_SEED / leftover promotion: greedy match radius for leftover detections to Gaia [px].
masterstar_lock_leftover_radius_px.label: Masterstar Lock Leftover Radius PX

masterstar_lock_pair_tol_px.help: Lock-existing assignment: max shift from locked catalog_id xy to detection [px].
masterstar_lock_pair_tol_px.label: Masterstar Lock Pair Tol PX

masterstar_min_matched_floor.help: Absolute floor of matched stars a masterstar solution must reach.
masterstar_min_matched_floor.label: Masterstar Min Matched Floor

masterstar_platesolve_sip_max_order.help: Highest SIP distortion polynomial order the solver may fit.
masterstar_platesolve_sip_max_order.label: Masterstar Platesolve SIP Max Order

masterstar_platesolve_sip_min_order.help: Lowest SIP distortion order tried by the solver.
masterstar_platesolve_sip_min_order.label: Masterstar Platesolve SIP Min Order

masterstar_prematch_peak_sigma_floor.help: Minimum peak significance of stars used in the pre-match stage.
masterstar_prematch_peak_sigma_floor.label: Masterstar Prematch Peak Sigma Floor

masterstar_quality_crowded_n_cat_min.help: Catalog-star count above which the masterstar quality checks switch to crowded-field mode.
masterstar_quality_crowded_n_cat_min.label: Masterstar Quality Crowded N Cat Min

masterstar_sibling_min_matched.help: Minimum matches a sibling (recovery) solution needs.
masterstar_sibling_min_matched.label: Masterstar Sibling Min Matched

masterstar_sibling_min_quadrants.help: Quadrant coverage required from a sibling solution.
masterstar_sibling_min_quadrants.label: Masterstar Sibling Min Quadrants

masterstar_sibling_recovery_enabled.help: Enables the sibling-stack recovery path when the primary masterstar solve fails.
masterstar_sibling_recovery_enabled.label: Masterstar Sibling Recovery Enabled

masterstar_sibling_rms_max_arcsec.help: Sibling recovery RMS gate in arcsec. None uses legacy masterstar_sibling_rms_max_px.
masterstar_sibling_rms_max_arcsec.label: Masterstar Sibling RMS Max Arcsec

masterstar_sibling_rms_max_px.help: RMS limit for accepting a sibling recovery solution.
masterstar_sibling_rms_max_px.label: Masterstar Sibling RMS Max PX

masterstar_sibling_stack_n.help: How many frames the sibling recovery stack combines.
masterstar_sibling_stack_n.label: Masterstar Sibling Stack N

masterstar_use_best_frame_fwhm.help: Uses the best frame's FWHM for masterstar detection kernels instead of an average.
masterstar_use_best_frame_fwhm.label: Masterstar Use Best Frame FWHM

neighbor_sub_centroid_max_fwhm.help: Maximum centroid shift (FWHM) allowed after neighbour subtraction.

neighbor_sub_chi2_max.help: Chi-square cap of the neighbour-model fit.
neighbor_sub_chi2_max.label: Neighbor Sub Chi2 Max

neighbor_sub_max_neighbor_overmag.help: Guard: the fitted neighbour must not come out brighter than expected by more than this (mag).
neighbor_sub_max_neighbor_overmag.label: Neighbor Sub Max Neighbor Overmag

neighbor_sub_max_target_undermag.help: Guard: the target must not lose more than this (mag) by the subtraction.
neighbor_sub_max_target_undermag.label: Neighbor Sub Max Target Undermag

neighbor_sub_min_recovered_snr.help: Minimum SNR the target must retain after neighbour subtraction.
neighbor_sub_min_recovered_snr.label: Neighbor Sub Min Recovered SNR

neighbor_sub_nn_contam_dmag.help: Brightness difference within which a nearest neighbour counts as contaminating.
neighbor_sub_nn_contam_dmag.label: Neighbor Sub NN Contam Dmag

neighbor_sub_refuse_sep_fwhm.help: Below this separation (FWHM) subtraction is refused - the pair is too blended to fix.
neighbor_sub_refuse_sep_fwhm.label: Neighbor Sub Refuse Sep FWHM

neighbor_sub_regime_dmag_min.help: Brightness-difference bound defining the regime where neighbour subtraction applies.
neighbor_sub_regime_dmag_min.label: Neighbor Sub Regime Dmag Min

neighbor_sub_regime_sep_max.help: Separation bound (FWHM) of the neighbour-subtraction regime.
neighbor_sub_regime_sep_max.label: Neighbor Sub Regime Sep Max

neighbor_sub_residual_rms_max.help: Residual RMS cap after subtraction for the result to be accepted.
neighbor_sub_residual_rms_max.label: Neighbor Sub Residual RMS Max

nonlinearity_fwhm_ratio.help: FWHM ratio threshold of the detector nonlinearity diagnostic (bright stars growing fatter than faint ones).
nonlinearity_fwhm_ratio.label: Nonlinearity FWHM Ratio

nonlinearity_peak_percentile.help: Peak-brightness percentile at which the nonlinearity diagnostic samples star shapes.
nonlinearity_peak_percentile.label: Nonlinearity Peak Percentile

observer_alt_m.help: Altitude of the observing site above sea level in meters; part of the site definition used for airmass and time corrections. WAVE-B removed the config.json copy - hydrated from the LOCATION row.
observer_alt_m.label: Observer Alt M

observer_code.help: Official AAVSO observer code stamped into every AAVSO export as #OBSCODE (and printed in reports). A warning is emitted only when this value is missing/empty.
observer_code.label: Observer Code

observer_lat.help: Latitude of the observing site in degrees. Hydrated from the draft's LOCATION record; WAVE-B removed the config.json copy.
observer_lat.label: Observer Lat

observer_location_id.help: Database ID of the currently selected observing site (LOCATION table row). This id stays in config.json and drives the hydration of the coordinates.
observer_location_id.label: Observer Location ID

observer_location_name.help: Human-readable name of the selected observing site (e.g. Jirny, Dablice). WAVE-B removed the config.json copy - hydrated from the LOCATION row.
observer_location_name.label: Observer Location Name

observer_lon.help: Longitude of the observing site in degrees; hydrated from the LOCATION row (WAVE-B removed the config.json copy).
observer_lon.label: Observer Lon

observer_name.help: Full observer name printed in reports.
observer_name.label: Observer Name

osc_channel_binning.help: OSC only: NxN average binning applied to each extracted channel (R/G/B/oneRGGB) after Bayer plane split. Allowed 1-4 (default 2). Total linear scale vs raw mosaic = 2 (superpixel) x N.
osc_channel_binning.label: OSC Channel Binning

per_frame_mp_reserve_ram_gb.help: RAM (GB) kept free per worker when sizing per-frame parallelism.
per_frame_mp_reserve_ram_gb.label: Per Frame MP Reserve RAM Gb

per_frame_sat_min_clean_frac.help: Minimum fraction of unsaturated frames required to measure a target when per-frame saturation is enabled (clamped 0.1..1.0).
per_frame_sat_min_clean_frac.label: Per Frame Sat Min Clean Frac

per_frame_saturation_enabled.help: When true, target saturation uses per-frame clean fraction instead of whole-star master zone skip (default false keeps legacy zone skip).
per_frame_saturation_enabled.label: Per Frame Saturation Enabled

phase01_chip_interior_margin_arcsec.help: Chip interior margin in arcsec. None uses legacy phase01_chip_interior_margin_px.
phase01_chip_interior_margin_arcsec.label: Phase01 Chip Interior Margin Arcsec

phase01_chip_interior_margin_px.help: Margin (px) from the chip edge inside which stars are excluded from comparison selection (edge effects).
phase01_chip_interior_margin_px.label: Phase01 Chip Interior Margin PX

phase01_comparison_exclude_gaia_extobj.help: Excludes Gaia-flagged extended objects (galaxies) from comparison candidates.
phase01_comparison_exclude_gaia_extobj.label: Phase01 Comparison Exclude Gaia Extobj

phase01_comparison_exclude_gaia_nss.help: Excludes Gaia non-single-star (binary) sources from comparison candidates.
phase01_comparison_exclude_gaia_nss.label: Phase01 Comparison Exclude Gaia NSS

phase01_comparison_fov_fraction.help: Fraction of the field of view around the target within which comparisons are searched.
phase01_comparison_fov_fraction.label: Phase01 Comparison FOV Fraction

phase01_comparison_isolation_radius_arcs.help: Comp isolation radius in arcsec. None uses legacy phase01_comparison_isolation_radius_px.
phase01_comparison_isolation_radius_arcs.label: Phase01 Comparison Isolation Radius Arcsec

phase01_comparison_isolation_radius_px.help: Isolation radius (px): a comparison must have no bright neighbour inside it.
phase01_comparison_isolation_radius_px.label: Phase01 Comparison Isolation Radius PX

phase01_comparison_mag_bright_threshold.help: Brightness above which the stricter bright-star mag-difference floor applies.
phase01_comparison_mag_bright_threshold.label: Phase01 Comparison Mag Bright Threshold

phase01_comparison_max_comp_rms.help: Absolute upper bound on comparison-star LOO mag MAD (INV-COMP-RMS-01). The gate is min(this, k x photon).
phase01_comparison_max_comp_rms.label: Phase01 Comparison Max Comp RMS

comp_rms_loo_photon_k.label: Comp RMS LOO Photon K

phase01_comparison_max_dist_deg.help: Maximum sky distance (deg) of a comparison from the target; density adaptation adds to the FOV-derived base.
phase01_comparison_max_dist_deg.label: Phase01 Comparison Max Dist Deg

phase01_comparison_max_dist_fov_frac.help: Max comp distance as fraction of half-diagonal FOV. None uses legacy max_dist_deg fallback.
phase01_comparison_max_dist_fov_frac.label: Phase01 Comparison Max Dist FOV Frac

phase01_comparison_max_fwhm_factor.help: Maximum FWHM ratio vs the field median a comparison may have (rejects defocused/blended shapes).
phase01_comparison_max_fwhm_factor.label: Phase01 Comparison Max FWHM Factor

phase01_comparison_max_mag_diff.help: Base maximum brightness difference (mag) between comparison and target; adapted by density profile.
phase01_comparison_max_mag_diff.label: Phase01 Comparison Max Mag Diff

phase01_comparison_max_mag_diff_absolute.help: Hard ceiling of the brightness difference no adaptation may exceed.
phase01_comparison_max_mag_diff_absolute.label: Phase01 Comparison Max Mag Diff Absolute

phase01_comparison_max_mag_diff_bright_f.help: Mag-difference floor applied to bright stars regardless of adaptation.
phase01_comparison_max_mag_diff_bright_f.label: Phase01 Comparison Max Mag Diff Bright Floor

phase01_comparison_max_psf_chi2.help: Maximum PSF-fit chi-square of a comparison star (shape sanity).
phase01_comparison_max_psf_chi2.label: Phase01 Comparison Max PSF Chi2

phase01_comparison_min_dist_arcsec.help: Minimum distance (arcsec) between comparison and target to avoid mutual contamination; density-adapted.
phase01_comparison_min_dist_arcsec.label: Phase01 Comparison Min Dist Arcsec

phase01_comparison_min_frames_frac.help: Minimum fraction of frames a comparison must be measured on.
phase01_comparison_min_frames_frac.label: Phase01 Comparison Min Frames Frac

phase01_comparison_n_comp_max.help: Maximum ensemble size; literature shows scintillation gains saturate around 6-8 comparisons.
phase01_comparison_n_comp_max.label: Phase01 Comparison N Comp Max

phase01_comparison_n_comp_min.help: Minimum comparisons the selector aims for; density adaptation may lower it on sparse fields.
phase01_comparison_n_comp_min.label: Phase01 Comparison N Comp Min

phase01_ct_extrapolation_tol.help: Allowed color-range extrapolation of the color-term relation (0 = no extrapolation).
phase01_ct_extrapolation_tol.label: Phase01 CT Extrapolation Tol

phase01_ct_min_comp.help: Minimum comparisons required to fit a color-term relation.
phase01_ct_min_comp.label: Phase01 CT Min Comp

phase01_flux_col.help: Which flux column feeds Phase-1 comparison statistics (dao_flux = detection-stage flux).
phase01_flux_col.label: Phase01 Flux Col

phase01_plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.help: Phase-1 plate scale; resolved from the WCS solution at run time. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback - the resolver is authoritative.
phase01_plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.label: Phase01 Plate Scale Arcsec Per PX

phase01_tiers.help: Brightness-difference bounds (mag) of the candidate magnitude tiers, ascending. WAVE-B merged the phase01_tier{1..4}_mag scalars into this list.
phase01_tiers.label: Phase01 Tiers

phase2a_airmass_before_outlier.help: Order switch: apply the airmass detrend before (True) or after (False) outlier rejection in Phase 2A.
phase2a_airmass_before_outlier.label: Phase2a Airmass Before Outlier

photometry_mode.help: Which measurement families run: aperture, PSF, or both.
photometry_mode.label: Photometry Mode

plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.help: Global plate scale (arcsec/px); resolved from the WCS at run time - the number that converts pixels to sky angles. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback.
plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.label: Plate Scale Arcsec Per PX

plate_solve_fov_deg.help: Field-of-view estimate (degrees) fed to the plate solver; computed from frame size and optics.
plate_solve_fov_deg.label: Plate Solve FOV Deg

preprocess_sky_surface_force_reapply.help: When true, bypass the sky-surface idempotency guard and re-subtract the model in-place (diagnostic / recovery only; default false preserves anchor byte-identity).
preprocess_sky_surface_force_reapply.label: Preprocess Sky Surface Force Reapply

preprocess_sky_surface_order.help: Polynomial order of the flux-conserving sky-surface background model subtracted before photometry (2 = gentle 2D gradient removal; part of the draft_435 anchor).
preprocess_sky_surface_order.label: Preprocess Sky Surface Order

project_root.help: VYVAR installation root; derived from the code location, never edit.
project_root.label: Project Root

psf_adaptive_enabled.help: Adaptive per-star routing between PSF and aperture measurement (PSF program is OFF pending the Newton dense-field gate).
psf_adaptive_enabled.label: PSF Adaptive Enabled

psf_adaptive_resolve_fwhm.help: Separation (FWHM) below which the adaptive router prefers PSF for blended pairs.
psf_adaptive_resolve_fwhm.label: PSF Adaptive Resolve FWHM

psf_adaptive_snr_lo.help: SNR below which the adaptive router prefers PSF measurement.
psf_adaptive_snr_lo.label: PSF Adaptive SNR Lo

psf_chi2_threshold.help: Chi-square limit of an acceptable PSF fit.
psf_chi2_threshold.label: PSF Chi2 Threshold

psf_zp_membership.help: Internal PSF LC ZP membership (INV-PSF-LC-PIN-01). fit_ok_strict uses stored psf_fit_ok. fit_ok_for_zp also admits epochs with finite psf_flux>0 and finite psf_chi2. Production default fit_ok_for_zp on validated rigs only.
psf_zp_membership.label: PSF ZP Membership

psf_zp_for_zp_validated_rigs.help: Rig identity keys equipment_id:telescope_id allowed to use fit_ok_for_zp. Draft 516/517 wide pair is 1:1. Unlisted rigs stay fit_ok_strict (EPSF-ZP-OK-XRIG-01).
psf_zp_for_zp_validated_rigs.label: PSF ZP For ZP Validated Rigs

psf_group_sep_fwhm.help: Separation (FWHM) within which stars are fitted together as a PSF group.
psf_group_sep_fwhm.label: PSF Group Sep FWHM

psf_grouper_enabled.help: Enables simultaneous group fitting of close stars in PSF photometry.
psf_grouper_enabled.label: PSF Grouper Enabled

psf_neighbor_include_fwhm.help: Radius (FWHM) within which neighbours are included in a PSF fit.
psf_neighbor_include_fwhm.label: PSF Neighbor Include FWHM

psf_neighbor_sub_enabled.help: Enables PSF-model neighbour subtraction before aperture measurement of blended targets.
psf_neighbor_sub_enabled.label: PSF Neighbor Sub Enabled

psf_photometry_enabled.help: Master switch of PSF photometry (currently OFF; enablement gated on the Newton dense-field validation).
psf_photometry_enabled.label: PSF Photometry Enabled

psf_quality_fallback_enabled.help: Falls back to the aperture measurement when a PSF fit fails quality checks.
psf_quality_fallback_enabled.label: PSF Quality Fallback Enabled

psf_spatial_enabled.help: Enables spatially varying PSF models across the frame.
psf_spatial_enabled.label: PSF Spatial Enabled

psf_spatial_order.help: Polynomial order of PSF spatial variation (0 = constant PSF).
psf_spatial_order.label: PSF Spatial Order

pytics_enabled.help: Enables the PyTICS-style iterative comparison calibration step of light-curve construction.
pytics_enabled.label: PYTICS Enabled

pytics_n_iter.help: Iteration count of the PyTICS-style calibration.
pytics_n_iter.label: PYTICS N Iter

qc_after_calibrate_enabled.help: Runs the full QC pass right after calibration and stores per-frame quality metrics.
qc_after_calibrate_enabled.label: QC After Calibrate Enabled

qc_dao_detection_sigma.help: Detection sensitivity (sigma above background) of the star finder used by QC to count stars per frame.
qc_dao_detection_sigma.label: QC DAO Detection Sigma

qc_max_background_rms.help: Optional cap on background noise RMS per frame; None disables the check.
qc_max_background_rms.label: QC Max Background RMS

qc_max_hfr.help: Maximum half-flux radius per frame - an alternative sharpness measure familiar from capture software.
qc_max_hfr.label: QC Max HFR

qc_max_hfr_fwhm_ratio.help: QC HFR limit as multiple of measured FWHM. None uses legacy qc_max_hfr px cap.
qc_max_hfr_fwhm_ratio.label: QC Max HFR FWHM Ratio

qc_min_stars.help: Minimum number of detected stars a frame needs to be considered usable.
qc_min_stars.label: QC Min Stars

qc_preprocess_workers.help: Number of parallel preprocessing workers; computed from CPU/RAM at startup, overridable by the VYVAR_PARALLEL_WORKERS environment variable.
qc_preprocess_workers.label: QC Preprocess Workers

read_noise.help: Detector read noise (electrons) in the error model; resolved DB-first (equipment-intrinsic), then FITS. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback.
read_noise.label: Read Noise

saturate_limit_fraction.help: Fraction of the detector's saturation level above which a star is treated as saturated and excluded from photometry.
saturate_limit_fraction.label: Saturate Limit Fraction

save_lightcurve_png.help: Also saves per-target light-curve PNG previews during the run.
save_lightcurve_png.label: Save Lightcurve Png

savgol_detrend_enabled.help: Optional Savitzky-Golay smoothing detrend; OFF by default for the same reason as other detrends.
savgol_detrend_enabled.label: Savgol Detrend Enabled

savgol_polyorder.help: Polynomial order of the Savitzky-Golay filter.
savgol_polyorder.label: Savgol Polyorder

savgol_window_frac.help: Window width (fraction of the series) of the Savitzky-Golay filter.
savgol_window_frac.label: Savgol Window Frac

sigma_sys_mag.help: Per-equipment systematic error floor (mag) added in quadrature; dict keys are equipment_id strings. Missing key -> explicit 0.0 with INFO log (WIDE-ERR-03); wide-rig equipment 1 interim is 0 (Stage-5 calibration owns residual floor).
sigma_sys_mag.label: Sigma Sys Mag

sips_dao_fwhm_fwhm_factor.help: Initial DAO FWHM as multiple of measured FWHM. None uses legacy sips_dao_fwhm_px.
sips_dao_fwhm_fwhm_factor.label: SIPS DAO FWHM Factor

sips_dao_fwhm_px.help: Assumed star FWHM (px) for the SIPS-style DAO detection preset.
sips_dao_fwhm_px.label: Sips DAO FWHM PX

sips_dao_threshold_sigma.help: Detection threshold (sigma) of the SIPS-style DAO preset.
sips_dao_threshold_sigma.label: Sips DAO Threshold Sigma

snr_cog_isolation_fwhm.help: Minimum neighbour separation in FWHM units for stars used to build the SNR-table measured growth curve.
snr_cog_isolation_fwhm.label: SNR COG Isolation FWHM

sparse_trust_T_green.help: Check-star T-statistic bound for GREEN trust on sparse fields.
sparse_trust_T_green.label: Sparse Trust T Green

sparse_trust_T_red.help: Check-star T-statistic bound beyond which sparse-field trust turns RED.
sparse_trust_T_red.label: Sparse Trust T Red

sparse_trust_X2_RED.help: Excess-variance bound turning sparse-field trust RED.
sparse_trust_X2_RED.label: Sparse Trust X2 RED

sysrem_enabled.help: Optional SysRem systematics removal (Tamuz+ 2005); OFF by default - validated as risky for preserving real variability.
sysrem_enabled.label: SYSREM Enabled

sysrem_n_iter.help: Number of SysRem iterations when enabled.
sysrem_n_iter.label: SYSREM N Iter

temporal_bin_window.help: Time-bin width for temporal binning (0 = none).
temporal_bin_window.label: Temporal Bin Window

temporal_binning_enabled.help: Temporal binning of light curves; OFF by design - injection testing proved it harmful (24/25 targets worse).
temporal_binning_enabled.label: Temporal Binning Enabled

tess_enabled.help: Enables the TESS cross-analysis block (comparing your light curve against TESS data).
tess_enabled.label: TESS Enabled

trust_flag_enabled.help: Master switch of the per-epoch trust flag written into results and exports.
trust_flag_enabled.label: Trust Flag Enabled

variability_clip_ratio_min.help: Minimum surviving-points ratio after sigma clipping for a star to stay in variability analysis.
variability_clip_ratio_min.label: Variability Clip Ratio Min

variability_comp_floor_factor.help: How many times above the comparison-star noise floor a star must scatter to count as variable.
variability_comp_floor_factor.label: Variability Comp Floor Factor

variability_mag_limit.help: Faint magnitude limit of the variability search.
variability_mag_limit.label: Variability Mag Limit

variability_min_amplitude_mag.help: Minimum amplitude (mag) for a variability candidate.
variability_min_amplitude_mag.label: Variability Min Amplitude Mag

variability_min_frames.help: Minimum frames a star must appear on to be analysed for variability.
variability_min_frames.label: Variability Min Frames

variability_min_frames_frac.help: Minimum fraction of the night's frames a star must cover for variability analysis.
variability_min_frames_frac.label: Variability Min Frames Frac

variability_min_points_rms.help: Minimum points needed before an RMS-based variability statistic is computed.
variability_min_points_rms.label: Variability Min Points RMS

variability_min_rms_pct.help: Percentile floor of the RMS-vs-magnitude relation used to normalize variability scores.
variability_min_rms_pct.label: Variability Min RMS Pct

variability_p85_filter.help: Percentile filter removing the noisiest tail before variability statistics.
variability_p85_filter.label: Variability P85 Filter

variability_sigma_threshold.help: Significance (sigma) a star's scatter must exceed to be flagged as a variability candidate.
variability_sigma_threshold.label: Variability Sigma Threshold

variability_slope_floor.help: Minimum slope of the excess-scatter trend considered meaningful in candidate scoring.
variability_slope_floor.label: Variability Slope Floor

variability_smoothness_max.help: Maximum smoothness score - very smooth curves are more likely trends/artifacts than stellar variability.

vsx_out_of_scope_types.help: List of VSX variability types to leave unmeasured (default empty = feature inactive). Matching: a target's VSX type string is tokenized on the separators |, /, + and whitespace; each token is uppercased and a trailing : (VSX uncertain-classification mark) is stripped; config entries are normalized the same way; a target is OUT OF SCOPE when ANY of its tokens equals ANY configured entry. Substring matching is NEVER used (e.g. M does not exclude SRM). Applies ONLY to VSX auto-selected targets; manually added targets are never filtered. Matched targets stay in active_targets.csv with skip_photometry=True and skip_reason=vsx_type_out_of_scope (mask-first). Out-of-scope stars remain known variables and stay purged from the comparison pool. Example: ["ROT"] excludes ROT and ROT: but keeps DSCT|GDOR|SXPHE.
vsx_out_of_scope_types.label: VSX Out Of Scope Types
